banks.intro: Three distinct occasions offer R (start a conversation) or S (stay alone). Each person freely chose and performed one option each time.
banks.event: Occasion {n}: Person {r} chose R; Person {s} chose S.
banks.sampling: A and B were drawn independently from the reference population. Only pairs with complementary R/S sequences were retained for this record. Pair selection used no other information.

banks.intro: On three separate occasions, R means initiate conversation and S means remain alone. Every person voluntarily performed one choice on every occasion.
banks.event: Time {n}: Person {r} selected R; Person {s} selected S.
banks.sampling: Both people were first sampled independently and randomly from the population below. The record retains only pairs whose R/S paths are opposite. Nothing else was used to select pairs.
